edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against superAdmin before transferring tokens out.
msg.sender is compared against superAdmin before burning tokens.
msg.sender must equal superAdmin to set the pending admin.
msg.sender must equal pendingSuperAdmin to accept ownership.
msg.sender must equal superAdmin to set delay days.
msg.sender must equal sbTimelock to update service minimum.
msg.sender must equal sbTimelock to update miner minimum.
msg.sender decides whether transferFrom is executed and is used as funder in mineFor.
msg.sender must equal sbController to receive rewards.
msg.sender is the miner identity and token funder in mine.
msg.sender selects whose mine accounting is reduced in unmine.
msg.sender is the miner and funder in mineForVotesOnly.
msg.sender selects the mineForVotes balance to reduce in unmineForVotesOnly.
msg.sender selects the claimer identity in claimAll.
msg.sender selects the claimer identity in claimUpTo.
block.timestamp determines seconds since start of day for the mine weighting.
block.timestamp is divided to derive the current day index.
removeTokens reads superAdmin for its authorization check.
removeTokens uses strongToken as the token to transfer.
removeTokens performs the strongToken.transfer call.
burnTokens reads superAdmin for its authorization check.
burnTokens uses strongToken as the token to transfer.
burnTokens performs the transfer to the dead address.
setPendingSuperAdmin checks the caller against superAdmin.
setPendingSuperAdmin writes pendingSuperAdmin.
acceptSuperAdmin checks the caller against pendingSuperAdmin.
acceptSuperAdmin writes superAdmin, changing privileged ownership.
setDelayDays checks the caller against superAdmin.
setDelayDays writes delayDays.
updateServiceMinMine checks caller against sbTimelock.
updateServiceMinMine writes serviceMinMine.
updateMinerMinMine checks caller against sbTimelock.
updateMinerMinMine writes minerMinMine.
mineFor uses strongToken to pull the mined amount.
mineFor queries sbController for start day and max years.
mineFor notifies sbVotes of vote changes.
mineFor updates per-miner and global accounting via _update.
mineFor derives the current day via _getCurrentDay.
mineFor executes the strongToken.transferFrom pull.
mineFor makes the sbVotes.updateVotes external call.
receiveRewards checks the caller against sbController.
receiveRewards uses strongToken to pull the reward amount.
receiveRewards increments dayRewards for the given day.
receiveRewards executes the strongToken.transferFrom pull.
mine uses strongToken to pull caller tokens.
mine queries sbController for start day and max years.
mine notifies sbVotes of vote changes.
mine updates accounting via _update.
mine derives the current day via _getCurrentDay.
mine executes the strongToken.transferFrom pull.
mine makes the sbVotes.updateVotes external call.
unmine uses strongToken to return tokens to the caller.
unmine notifies sbVotes of the vote decrease.
unmine updates accounting via _update.
unmine derives the current day via _getCurrentDay.
unmine executes the strongToken.transfer to the caller.
unmine makes the sbVotes.updateVotes external call.
mineForVotesOnly uses strongToken to pull caller tokens.
mineForVotesOnly queries sbController for start day and max years.
mineForVotesOnly increments mineForVotes for the caller.
mineForVotesOnly notifies sbVotes of the vote increase.
mineForVotesOnly derives the current day via _getCurrentDay.
mineForVotesOnly executes the strongToken.transferFrom pull.
mineForVotesOnly makes the sbVotes.updateVotes external call.
unmineForVotesOnly decreases the caller mineForVotes balance.
unmineForVotesOnly uses strongToken to return tokens to the caller.
unmineForVotesOnly notifies sbVotes of the vote decrease.
unmineForVotesOnly executes the strongToken.transfer to the caller.
unmineForVotesOnly makes the sbVotes.updateVotes external call.
claimAll reads delayDays to enforce the claim delay.
claimAll reads and later updates minerDayLastClaimedFor.
claimAll queries sbController for the start day default.
claimAll delegates the reward computation and payout to _claim.
claimAll derives the current day via _getCurrentDay.
claimUpTo reads delayDays to enforce the claim delay.
claimUpTo reads and later updates minerDayLastClaimedFor.
claimUpTo queries sbController for the start day default.
claimUpTo delegates the reward computation and payout to _claim.
claimUpTo derives the current day via _getCurrentDay.
_claim subtracts delayDays when recording the last claimed day.
_claim writes minerDayLastClaimedFor for the miner.
_claim computes the payout amount with _getRewardsDue.
_claim performs an external self-call this.mineFor which can re-enter before the claim state is fully settled.
_claim emits the current day via _getCurrentDay.
_getRewardsDue reads delayDays to bound the reward loop.
_getRewardsDue reads dayRewards for each day in the loop.
_update relies on block.timestamp to compute the remaining seconds in the day.

amount parameter drives unmine accounting and token return.
amount parameter drives vote-only mine accounting and token pull.
amount parameter reduces vote-only mine and is returned.
day parameter bounds the claim in claimUpTo.
upToDay parameter bounds the reward computation in _claim.
miner parameter selects the account credited in _claim.
dayLastClaimedFor parameter seeds the reward loop in _claim.
rewards local variable gates and forwards the payout amount.
amount parameter updates mine amounts in _update.
adding flag selects add or subtract branches in _update.
currentDay parameter positions the accounting entry in _update.
upToDay parameter bounds the reward loop in _getRewardsDue.
rewards local variable accumulates the pro-rata amounts.
